tweets.text:
Main diffs between fwa and TCG gachas for me 

1) keeping the common tier reward feels moronic with fwa unless the depositer messed up the pricing. With TCG gachas, some of the common cards are nice at market price and I keep them 

2) farming of the FWA is honest, farming of every TCG gacha token is dishonest. This is what makes the “77% RTP” argument a bad one imo. You are knowingly eating shit to buy the token because that’s the only way to accumulate the token. On TCG platforms, you’re accumulating the old point program ponzi and hoping the platform does right by you in the future (we’ve seen more platforms than not do wrong by the user so can’t assume good things will happen here) 

3) anyone can deposit and be the house, makes sourcing of assets significantly easier. This is also turning into a “problem” for some as they see TTTs backed by 100+ ETH value, rather than NFTs worth 100+ ETH 

Honestly looking forward to FWA with a combination of TCG gacha common rewards, higher pulling EV after token farming, and a stricter depositor decorum
